helpful: CourtListener MCP search and read_document retrieved the complete 56-page Seventh Circuit opinion and dissent below (Rojas v. Olson, No. 25-3127, decided July 30, 2026), which was critical because Supreme Court filings in this immigration habeas case are paper-only under Rule 34.6.

fedcourts query --docket-number quickly confirmed that the Supreme Court already granted certiorari on October 1, 2026 in the lead Second Circuit vehicle on the identical 8 U.S.C. 1225(b)(2)(A) question (Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha, No. 26-104) and is holding the Sixth and Fifth Circuit companion petitions (Nos. 25-1415 and 26-43).

gaps: A --counsel or --party filter on fedcourts query would make it easier to locate related Solicitor General or ICE field-office petitions without knowing their exact docket numbers in advance.
notes: Because Rule 34.6 paper-only filing applies to immigration cases at the Supreme Court, combining CourtListener MCP lower-court opinion retrieval with fedcourts query docket lookups was essential to identifying this petition as a follow-on SG hold petition for Rhoney v. Barbosa da Cunha (No. 26-104).
